meta.phase: Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)

locations.name: Bunia
locations.notes: Primary outbreak epicentre. One of nine affected health zones.

locations.name: Mongbwalu
locations.notes: Mining community with high population mobility. Cluster of 4 healthcare worker deaths.

locations.name: Rwampara
locations.notes: Initial laboratory confirmation site (8/13 samples positive).

locations.name: Goma
locations.notes: Confirmed case in city under M23 rebel control. Containment significantly complicated by security situation.

locations.name: Kampala
locations.notes: Two confirmed cases (one fatal) in travellers from DRC. First international spread.

locations.name: Kinshasa
locations.notes: Previously reported case tested negative on confirmatory testing by INRB. No longer counted.

timeline.event: Cluster of unexplained haemorrhagic fever deaths flagged in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, DRC.
Bundibugyo virus confirmed by laboratory (8 of 13 samples positive). First confirmed case detected in Kampala, Uganda.
Second confirmed Kampala case (fatal). Suspected Kinshasa case reported (later retracted).
WHO Director-General declares Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).
Outbreak expands from 3 to 9+ health zones in DRC. New confirmed case in Goma (under M23 rebel control). US CDC enacts enhanced travel screening.

alerts.title: PHEIC Declared
alerts.body: WHO has determined this outbreak constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

alerts.title: US CDC Travel Health Notices Active
alerts.body: Enhanced screening and entry measures implemented for travellers from DRC and Uganda.

alerts.title: No Approved Therapeutics or Vaccines
alerts.body: Unlike Ebola-Zaire, there are no licensed treatments or vaccines specific to Bundibugyo virus. Candidate trials being initiated.
